name: loop-kit-dev
description: [DEV] Flow and turn-gate loop plugin that shapes work into flows and keeps one turn alive until explicit user stop.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Flow rules plus turn-gated continuity for multi-flow agent work.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides flow for bounded work classification and turn-gate for turn continuity, verification, next-flow routing, and mid-flow interruption handling.
defaultPrompt: Use flow to classify work into bounded flows, then use turn-gate to keep the turn open until I explicitly stop.
After each flow reports, treat reporting as pre-intake for the next user decision and reopen next-flow choices instead of ending the turn.
If a later user message arrives after an explicit or accidental stop, reactivate turn-gate and start fresh intake.
